peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the principle of sodium alginate beads?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Beads form because the sodium alginate drops are round and begin to crosslink once they hit the calcium chloride solution. A gel shell forms around the bead and thickens when the bead is left in solution. This happens because of diffusion.
